subject: Request: audit addendum & post-period artifacts — Glasstone Labs
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@glasstone.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@glasstone.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 17:14:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II addendum request / post-report artifacts

Hi Karthik,

Quick note from Glasstone's procurement and security team — we are preparing our vendor assessment for Q4 and need to close the gap between Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2026-06-30) and our assessment date. Specifically:

- Can Redwood provide a post-period "addendum" or management assertion (sometimes called a bridge letter) that covers the period from 2026-07-01 through today (we're asking for coverage through 2026-11-25)?
- If a bridge/addendum is available, can you confirm whether it will: (a) state that there have been no material changes to the control environment included in the SOC 2 report, and (b) list any known, non-remediated gaps?
- Please include details on whether the document will be signed by management and whether Redwood's auditor will endorse or sign off (Glasstone sometimes requires a signature by an officer or the auditor).

Additionally, could you provide these artifacts (redacted is fine):
- The SOC 2 Type II report PDF for the period ending 2026-06-30
- Management assertion / bridge letter (draft or final)
- High-level change log or summary of control changes since 2026-07-01 (if any)
- A short evidence pack (sample access logs, KMS configuration summary, retention policy link)

Timing: we are aiming to complete the review by 2026-12-01. Can you confirm if Redwood can turn around a draft within 3–5 business days and a signed letter within two weeks? Also let us know the contact for Redwood's auditor if Glasstone's security team needs direct confirmation.

Thanks — appreciate the quick help.

Samantha Ortiz
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
Glasstone Labs
samantha.ortiz@glasstone.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@glasstone.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 18:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II addendum request / post-report artifacts

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear note and timing. Looping in Laura (Security) and Marissa (Compliance / Legal) so we can pull the right artifacts and confirm signing authority.

A few clarifying questions to make sure we deliver what Glasstone needs: 
1) Do you require a signed management assertion only, or do you specifically need the external auditor to sign/endorse the bridge letter? (Both are common; our default is a signed management assertion.)
2) Is Glasstone's security team satisfied with redacted copies of the SOC 2 report and KMS details, or do you need unredacted artifacts for auditor review?
3) For the evidence pack, is a representative sample (e.g., one week of access logs, a KMS key policy excerpt, and a retention policy PDF) sufficient or do you need continuous exports?

Our proposed timeline (subject to any auditor coordination you request):
- Acknowledgement and scoping today (we've done that)
- Internal draft bridge/management assertion within 3 business days (target: 2026-11-27)
- If a signature from our external auditor is requested, we will need to coordinate with them — that may extend finalization by up to 7–10 business days depending on their availability.

Laura / Marissa — can you confirm whether there have been material control changes since 2026-06-30 and whether we have a draft addendum we can share for Glasstone's review?

Karthik
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@glasstone.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II addendum request / post-report artifacts

Hi Samantha — thanks, and welcome — I'm Laura on the security team. Quick status update and I attached a first-draft addendum and a redacted copy of the SOC 2 report to this thread. Also attached a small sample of access logs and a KMS configuration excerpt for evidence.

Summary (high level):
- Control environment: No material changes to the control environment covered by the 2026-06-30 SOC 2 Type II report.
- Known exceptions: We have no open, material exceptions that would affect the scope of the SOC 2 report for the post-period dates (2026-07-01 through 2026-11-25). Any operational items we track are remediated according to our internal tracker and do not rise to the level of a reportable deviation.
- Draft addendum: Attached is a management assertion/bridge addendum (redwood_bridge_letter_draft_20261125.docx). The draft states the scope, the report end date, the post-period coverage dates, and management's assertion that there were no material control changes. It does not include auditor signature.

Attachments included (all stubs in this exchange):
- redwood_bridge_letter_draft_20261125.docx (management assertion / draft bridge)
- SOC2_TypeII_20260630-Redwood.pdf (redacted)
- access_logs_sample_202611.csv (one-week sample)

Questions for Glasstone:
- Would you accept a management-signed addendum without auditor endorsement? If auditor endorsement is required, please share the auditor contact and any specific attest language they prefer.
- Do you need the addendum on company letterhead with an officer signature (CFO/VP Finance) or is a head-of-security signature acceptable for your internal review?

Next steps: 
- If Glasstone confirms management-signature is sufficient, we can provide a signed PDF within 3 business days after you confirm the draft language (we can also add a sentence about no material control changes since the report end date).
- If auditor endorsement is requested, we'll coordinate and come back with expected timelines.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-minute call if you want to walk through the draft.

Laura Bennett
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
(650) 555-0199
